[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomen Karr]] had a '''safe house''' located in the [[Bog]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==History==
At some time either during the [[Great Galactic War]] or earlier in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Nomen Karr operated as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] spy for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. For some time, he had embedded himself into the vast intelligence network established by [[Darth Baras]], but eventually was forced to abandon his assignment. It was there that Karr betrayed Baras.<ref name="The Padawan Exposed" />

Later, during the Cold War, Nomen Karr sought to defend [[Jaesa Willsaam|his apprentice]] when he challenged Baras to a duel at this safe house in [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Baras ordered [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]] to go in his stead, and there, Jedi Master and Sith apprentice [[Duel on Hutta|dueled]]. Nomen Karr was eventually defeated, and his apprentice turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and recruited to the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith Order]] by Baras' apprentice.<ref name="The Padawan Exposed" />
